name: Anti-Gradient Operator GENESIS: Invert the arrow of the divergence map from tensor to covector. FORMAL_SEED: D^{flat}(M) → M* via [v] ↦ (ω) := -∑ (∇_i f) δ^i STRANGE_PROPERTY: The vector field v vanishing does not imply its image is zero; the differential 1-form is a coboundary with the sign of a divergence. NEAREST_KNOWN_RELATIVE: De Rham complex of 1-forms WHY_NOT_JUST_RENAMING: The operator now squares to zero instead of zero (a true differential d=d) COUNTERFEIT: Classical Divergence theorem BREAK_IT: The composition is not identity but minus a homotopy NEXT_MUTATION: Take the exterior derivative of this new 1-form
